title: Translate a delivered datasheet summary (domain reviewer)
context: Translating a delivered datasheet summary widens reuse, but biomedical content needs a bilingual domain reviewer and must keep the "research metadata only — not medical advice" label intact. Only an already-delivered datasheet is translated, never raw data. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Translate one delivered datasheet summary into a target language, domain-reviewed, with the not-medical-advice label preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: An already-delivered datasheet summary is translated into a target language by/with a bilingual domain reviewer.
The "research metadata only — not medical advice" label and all license/provenance notices are preserved in the translation.
Translation reviewed for biomedical accuracy; output licensed CC-BY-4.0; no individual-level data introduced.
